decisions.notes: Tax acronym is explicit; quotation excludes tax from its displayed total without claiming any legal rate. Both Chinese aliases identify the tax, not a vessel. No barrel inflection is borrowed.
New text explicitly teaches standard BSc and Bachelor of Science; chemistry degree context and translation agree. This does not certify or erase the separate existing Commerce expansion.
Adjective modifies paragraph; explanation of judging which design works best makes the evaluation sense clear. Chinese translation and two bounded adjective aliases agree.
New text selects the usual lower-case software noun bot; automatic booking reminders concretely demonstrate it. Only the case variant bot is declared; it is not a claim about tape or larvae.
Sentence adverb evaluates a concerning rising water level; it does not describe a person acting worriedly. Chinese stance translation is accurate.
Train-timetable enthusiasm fits the specialised-interest adjective. Informal and potentially disparaging register are disclosed; translated interest and practical travel context are natural.
University primary instructions explicitly describe hand-held classroom clickers and voting on questions. New sentence demonstrates that device noun; it is not the old factory foreman sense.
Swimming-stroke noun and Chinese frog-stroke meaning agree. Practice at the shallow end is plausible and does not invent a swimming rule.
Element symbol is correctly cased and means hafnium, atomic number 72. Alloy composition is a natural symbol-use context; old 铃 typo is not retained as a real element.
Human document-preparation role is clear in tax-return preparer; requesting missing receipts before completing forms is supported by the IRS context. Revised reference is a real substantive IRS page.
Oxford explicitly records mmm as an exclamation spelling variant. First bite and perceived sweetness make the appreciative sound clear; Chinese quotation matches.
Impact interjection plus a shutter hitting a wall demonstrates the sound sense. The Chinese sound and gust-caused action agree; no computing or deception expansion is implied.
Adverb modifies spoke; the original silver-thread metaphor gives concrete poetic language. Chinese preserves the metaphor and river referent.
Adjective modifies manuscript and identifies the traditional Indian medical system without claiming efficacy. It is not incorrectly treated as the noun Ayurveda.
Explicit sociological scope is narrower than all philosophy senses; greetings shaping belonging plausibly illustrate social interaction and meaning. Person-noun POS and translation agree.
Tax use is explicit; receipt retention while checking eligible expenses is natural. The example makes no universal legal deductibility assertion and does not confuse deduction with inference.
ICTV supports the family, epithelial infection and non-human hosts. Tissue DNA testing is a concrete laboratory context, with no assertion that all papillomaviruses are human HPV.
Pieces placed into flatbread correctly distinguish the fried food from the sandwich that can contain it. Ingredient definition says usually, so it does not exclude other traditional legumes.
Adjective describes a beast-like howl; this matches Collins animal-resembling sense and the translated creature action. It does not claim the source pornography gloss is the same sense.
Adjective is correctly applied to labelled yoghurt. The translation describes its contents rather than asserting a health outcome; neither efficacy nor pre-life chemistry is implied.
Collins records the adverb. Future usefulness of extra seats is a natural stance use; Chinese conveys the intended certainty, with the less-common form stated.
A person celebrating victory while overlooking the narrow margin illustrates the boastful winner noun. The Chinese does not present ordinary confidence as necessarily insulting.
Wild American cat noun is correctly specified as 虎猫. Camera, dusk and quiet movement are plausible concrete context; it is not silently equated with the Asian leopard cat.
Three thousandths of an inch is 0.003 inch; the plural fractional noun and Chinese measure agree. The revised alias removes the ambiguous nonstandard 千分位份额 wording.
NOAA explicitly defines a silvered salmonid about to enter or newly in the sea, not a fixed age. Downstream estuary movement is natural and the translation preserves the life stage.
Hired hansom is a natural count noun for the historic vehicle. The two-wheel and usual single-horse definition is compatible with the cited carriage sense; the surname is separate.
Predicative adjective describes a lively market atmosphere caused by musicians and stalls. Chinese is natural; no drill-device meaning is borrowed.
Kew connects neem/nimtree with Azadirachta indica. Shade beside a courtyard is a concrete tree use, without medicinal efficacy assertions or Estonian-geography conflation.
Collins chippy entry explicitly records also chippie for a British takeaway shop. A portion of chips at a station-side shop is natural; the US person senses remain separate.

The 2026 NFL rulebook defines opposing impetus and a dead ball on/behind the defended goal line, excluding touchdown/incomplete pass. The definition is qualified, and a returner downing the ball in the end zone is a plausible specific play.

Merriam-Webster derives this clinical adverb and a primary PubMed abstract attests psychotically depressed. The authored referral sentence specifies delusions with depression; translation preserves the clinical condition and avoids casual abuse.
Food-context adverb modifies smooth; pleasant texture and vanilla provide real sensory context. Chinese conveys the appealing texture without pretending the word is an adjective.
Person who delegates work is demonstrated through setting a goal while giving colleagues discretion. Noun, explanation and translation align; this is not a delegation member.
Informal verb with to plus galumph and a bounding puppy is grammatical and concrete. The new clumsy sense is distinct from the verified rarer triumphant older sense.

Agent noun and European-institution advocacy agree. Cambridge documents both Russian Westernizers and a separate Georgian political grouping; broader person scope is supported without falsely limiting every use to Russia.
American slang friend noun fits an old-neighbourhood friend helping a move. Chinese preserves that social relationship, not the adjective home-like/comfortable.
Adverb modifies replacing a cable before a fault; Chinese clearly expresses prevention rather than a disease-only adjective. No universal maintenance recommendation is made.
The adjective is explicitly tied to perspective/scene painting. Painted arches creating apparent room depth demonstrate that scope, rather than an undefined broad staging claim.
Adverb qualifies relatedness in evolutionary history. Similar appearance with distant relationship is scientifically plausible, and the negative relation is preserved in Chinese.
Dog noun, parent breeds and plural cockapoos agree. Carrying a lead by the door is a natural concrete canine scene; the name is not falsely called an initialism.

Formal adverb with were used describes mutually supporting interview and survey evidence. Revised Chinese naturally states that they complement each other, preserving rather than mechanically copying the grammar.
Collins explicitly records the noun as informal dynamometer. Measuring engine power under load is a concrete device use; no excellent/adjective gloss is borrowed.
Adverb modifies repeated model adjustment. Checking each version gives real iterative context, with a natural matching Chinese translation.

Lettered bra cup size is unambiguous in an A-cup bra; the noun is used attributively. The definition is compositionally supported by the bra-cup entry; it does not claim a universal volume or connect acupuncture.
Merriam-Webster directly records the grade noun A-plus. Earned an A-plus for an essay is natural; Chinese preserves the academic mark, not a mathematical sign.
Stanford describes explanatory inference that does not guarantee truth. Leak rather than rain is a plausible explanatory hypothesis, and the Chinese retains its tentative status.
NFC Forum explicitly expands near field communication and documents payment/card emulation. Phone near reader is a natural specific use, independent of the football acronym.

FAA explicitly expands air traffic control. ATC giving a pilot an instruction is natural institutional metonymy; Chinese sensibly names the controllers and does not borrow a computer-controller expansion.

CFA Institute explicitly expands discounted cash flow and relates valuation to expected cash flows and discounting. The sentence asks how a higher rate changes valuation without giving investment advice or a numeric result.

Merriam-Webster explicitly lists mathematic as a less-common adjective variant. The authored example uses the exact target word, rather than falsely treating mathematical as an inflection; the usage note recommends the usual modern form.
